title: 2023年6月四级真题 第2套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 The traditional school year, with three months of vacation every summer, was first implemented when America was an agricultural society and the summer months were needed for farm work. Since then, we've completely changed as a nation. Students no longer spend summers farming, but they aren't in school, either. The average American student receives 13 weeks off from school each calendar year- with about 11 of those during the summer. Few other countries have more than seven weeks off in a school calendar.

P2 With the U.S. lagging behind other countries in academics, it's time to consider year-round schooling. One benefit of this change is that students will not fall victim to the "summer slide," or the well-documented phenomenon where students forget some of the knowledge they have acquired when too much time is taken off from school. Decades of research shows that it can take from 8 to 13 weeks at the beginning of every school year for students to get back to where they were before the summer holiday.

P3 But year-round schooling isn't just about academics. Teachers and students experience a closer relationship in year-round schools than they do in traditional schools and, in the absence of any long- term break, students do not feel detached from the school environment. These closer bonds and greater attachment pay off. Research shows that students in year-round schools are more self-confident and feel more positive about their schooling experience.

P4 But don't kids need time to relax? Some childhood development experts believe that time off from school is vital to healthy development as kids are not designed to spend so much of their time inside classrooms and the summer break provides a perfect opportunity to get outside. The problem with this argument is that most children aren't playing outside or even spending time with other kids. While some children visit summer camps, most stay at home, watching TV or playing games on electronic devices, which hardly benefits them.

P5 The U.S. has changed from a farming economy to a knowledge- and innovation-based economy, so it makes sense for the school year to change as well.

questions.q: Why did America's traditional school year have a three-month summer vacation?
options: Students needed to help with farm work.
Students needed time to learn necessary farming skills.
The agricultural society then attached less importance to academics.
America lagged behind other countries in making a scientific school calendar.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why did America's traditional school year have a three-month summer vacation? 问 一个写在文中的具体事实原因，答案应能在原文直接找到。

【拆句】Q51 是一个 Why 引导的特殊疑问句，主干就是 school year have a three-month summer vacation，没有从句也没有否定，结构平铺直叙、无陷阱。 51. Why did America's traditional school year have a three-month summer vacation? A) Students needed to help with farm work. B) Students needed time to learn necessary farming skills. C) The agricultural society then attached less importance to academics. D) America lagged behind other countries in making a scientific school calendar.

【定位】The traditional school year, with three months of vacation every summer, was first implemented when America was an agricultural society and the summer months were needed for farm work. 传统学年带有每年夏季三个月假期，它最初设立于美国还是农业社会、夏季几个月需要用于 农活的时候。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 the summer months were needed for farm work ↔Students needed to help with farm work 预判的"夏天要干农活"与 Students needed to help with farm work 完全吻合，故锁定 此项。 B) 无中生有 原文只说夏季需要去做农活，从未提学生需要时间去"学习"农业技能，learn necessary farming skills 文中没有依据。 C) 无中生有 原文只说当时是农业社会、夏天要务农，并未说农业社会 attached less importance to academics，这是文中没有的因果。 D) 张冠李戴 America lagged behind other countries 出自第二段 With the U.S. lagging behind other countries in academics，那是"如今"现状，并非当初设三个月暑假的原因，张冠 李戴。 除了提高学习成绩之外,全年制教育还会给学生带来什么好处? A) 它将帮助他们回到课程开始的地方。 B) 它将使他们能够消化所学的知识。 C) 它将使他们熟悉学校环境。 D) 它将加强他们与教师的关系。

questions.q: What benefit will year-round schooling bring students in addition to improving their learning?
options: It will help them get back to where their lessons started.
It will enable them to absorb what they have learned.
It will familiarize them with the school environment.
It will strengthen their relationship with teachers.
questions.explain:
【判型】What benefit will year-round schooling bring students in addition to improving their learning? 问一项写在文中的具体好处，属可直接核对的事实。

【拆句】Q52 主干是 What benefit will year-round schooling bring students，后接介词短语 in addition to improving their learning 作限定，提醒答案要排除学业类好处，是理解 关键。 52. What benefit will year-round schooling bring students in addition to improving their learning? A) It will help them get back to where their lessons started. B) It will enable them to absorb what they have learned. C) It will familiarize them with the school environment. D) It will strengthen their relationship with teachers.

【定位】But year-round schooling isn't just about academics. Teachers and students experience a closer relationship in year-round schools than they do in traditional schools and, in the absence of any long-term break, students do not feel detached from the school environment. 但全年制不仅仅关乎学业。在全年制学校里，师生关系比在传统学校里更亲近，而且由于没 有任何长期假期，学生不会感到与校园环境疏离。

【选项】A) 答非所问 get back to where their lessons started 套用第二段 get back to where they were， 那讲的是暑期遗忘后补回进度，属学业范畴，被题干限定排除，且原文是消除这一损耗 而非"帮学生回到起点"。 B) 答非所问 absorb what they have learned 仍是讲学习吸收，属 improving their learning 范 畴，被题干"除学业外"排除。 C) 偷换概念 原文说的是学生 do not feel detached from the school environment（不疏离），并 非 familiarize them with the school environment（使其熟悉环境），把"不疏远"偷 换成"变熟悉"。 D) ✓ 正确 Teachers and students experience a closer relationship ↔ strengthen their relationship with teachers 预判的"师生关系更近"正对应 strengthen their relationship with teachers，且它落 在"学业之外"的范围内，故选此项。 一些儿童发展专家对漫长的暑假有什么看法? A) 它满足了学生自主学习的需求。 B) 它使学生能够了解外部世界。 C) 它满足了学生希望在家待更长时间的愿望。 D) 它有助于学生的健康成长。

questions.q: What do some childhood development experts believe about the long summer vacation?
options: It meets students' need to study on their own.
It enables students to learn about the outside world.
It satisfies students' desire to stay longer at home.
It contributes to students' healthy growth.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do some childhood development experts believe about the long summer vacation? 问的是专家在文中直接表述的观点，可逐字核对，不需要读者推断。

【拆句】Q53 主干 What do some childhood development experts believe，后接 about the long summer vacation 点明评论对象；注意主语是 experts 而非作者，是"这话谁说的"的 关键。 53. What do some childhood development experts believe about the long summer vacation? A) It meets students' need to study on their own. B) It enables students to learn about the outside world. C) It satisfies students' desire to stay longer at home. D) It contributes to students' healthy growth.

【定位】Some childhood development experts believe that time off from school is vital to healthy development as kids are not designed to spend so much of their time inside classrooms and the summer break provides a perfect opportunity to get outside. 一些儿童发展专家认为，离开学校的休息时间对健康成长至关重要，因为孩子天生不适合把 这么多时间花在教室里，而暑假正好提供了走到户外的绝佳机会。

【选项】A) 无中生有 专家强调的是休息和户外，从未说放假满足学生 study on their own（自学）的需要， 原文无此意。 B) 过度推断 原文只说暑假给孩子 a perfect opportunity to get outside（到户外的机会），并不 等于 learn about the outside world（了解外部世界），后者把"到户外"拔高成"认识 世界"。 C) 张冠李戴 专家观点里没有"满足学生 stay longer at home"的说法；待在家看电视是后文作者反驳 时提到的现实，并非专家所赞同的需求。 D) ✓ 正确 time off from school is vital to healthy development ↔ It contributes to students' healthy growth 预判的"放假利于健康成长"正对应 It contributes to students' healthy growth，故选 此项。 反对专家关于漫长暑假观点的论据是什么? A) 它对大多数学生没什么好处。 B) 它只让少数在户外玩耍的学生受益。 C) 它导致学生忽视学业。 D) 它使学生沉迷于电脑游戏。

questions.q: What is the argument against the experts' idea of a long summer vacation?
options: It does little good to most students.
It benefits few students playing outside.
It leads students to neglect their studies.
It makes students addicted to computer games.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the argument against the experts' idea of a long summer vacation? 问一个写 在文中的具体反驳理由，可直接核对。

【拆句】Q54 主干 What is the argument against the experts' idea，介词 against 决定方向 是"反对专家"；读懂 against 才不会把专家自己的话误当反驳，是理解关键。 54. What is the argument against the experts' idea of a long summer vacation? A) It does little good to most students. B) It benefits few students playing outside. C) It leads students to neglect their studies. D) It makes students addicted to computer games.

【定位】The problem with this argument is that most children aren't playing outside or even spending time with other kids. While some children visit summer camps, most stay at home, watching TV or playing games on electronic devices, which hardly benefits them. 这个论点的问题在于，大多数孩子并没有在户外玩耍，甚至没有和别的孩子相处。虽然有些 孩子去参加夏令营，但多数人待在家里看电视或玩电子设备上的游戏，这对他们几乎没有 好处。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 most stay at home, watching TV or playing games on electronic devices, which hardly benefits them ↔It does little good to most students 预判的"对多数孩子没好处"正对应 It does little good to most students，故选此项。 B) 以偏概全 原文 hardly benefits them 说的是待在家的"多数"孩子没好处，benefits few students playing outside 却把对象缩成"在外面玩的少数"，偷改了范围。 C) 无中生有 作者反驳讲的是放假对孩子无益，并未说放假让学生 neglect their studies（荒废学 业），文中无此意。 D) 以偏概全 原文把看电视和玩电子设备游戏并列为现象之一，并未断言放假使学生 addicted to computer games（沉迷电脑游戏），把众多居家活动之一夸成"上瘾"。 作者如何看待当今美国的传统学年? A) 有充分根据的。 B) 受文化束缚的。 C) 过时的。 D) 受欢迎的。

questions.q: What does the author think of the traditional school year in the U.S. today?
options: Well-grounded.
Culture-bound.
Outdated.
Welcomed.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author think of the traditional school year in the U.S. today? 问的是作 者对旧学制的整体评价，需通览全文立场而非某句。

【拆句】Q55 主干 What does the author think of the traditional school year，关键是 today ——问的是"在今天看来"旧学制如何，提示要结合文章"时代已变"的论调判断，是解题 关键。 55. What does the author think of the traditional school year in the U.S. today? A) Well-grounded. B) Culture-bound. C) Outdated. D) Welcomed.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 Well-grounded（有充分根据的）是褒义，意味旧学制合理；而作者全篇主张它该改， 态度恰好相反。 B) 无中生有 文章把旧学制归因于"农业经济"这一时代背景，并未从"文化"角度评价，Culture- bound（受文化局限）在原文找不到落点。 C) ✓ 正确 The U.S. has changed from a farming economy to a knowledge- and innovation-based economy, so it makes sense for the school year to change as well ↔Outdated 预判的"旧学制已不合时宜、该改"与 Outdated 一词对应，故选此项。 D) 与原文相反 Welcomed（受欢迎的）是褒义，暗示作者赞许旧学制；而作者主张它该改、显然不持 欢迎态度，方向相反。
